messages:
taylor-sales: Heads up — HealthSync procurement just sent PO request. They want: split billing across two entities, net60, and a DPA redline that includes BYOK/KMS. They say signature needs to follow their AP queue (two POs). Can we confirm path?

sam-se: Quick Q — is this POC still under the discounted POC pricing we quoted? If so, finance might push back on net60 for the POC. Need usage forecast to size billing.

rachel-legal: @taylor-sales please paste the redline they sent. For BYOK/KMS: our standard is customer-managed keys for Dedicated/Private; for Hosted we require SOC/HSM controls + limited BYOK language. If they insist on full BYOK for hosted, we need a legal escalation.

taylor-sales: pasted their note + order form snippet below (they prefer single envelope if possible):

```
Order form lines:
- 1 x Redwood Dedicated pool (24 GPUs) — term 12m — $85k/mo
- 1 x Hosted API (overage) — estimate 500k tokens/mo — $0.0004/token
Billing split: 60% Entity A (Prod), 40% Entity B (Research)
Requested net: 60
POs: two separate PO numbers (one per entity)
```

jordan-ops: DocuSign constraint: our current template supports multi-signer but not multi-PO mapping in a single envelope. Options: (1) create 2 envelopes and link them in SFDC, (2) attach a single order form and include PO mapping table inside the doc (finance then assigns after). Which do we prefer?

maya-finance: Net60 for new customers requires credit review. For POC we can make exception: net30 + milestone invoice (45 days after first run) or accept net45 if AM confirms forecast. Also need tax IDs for both entities and exact PO numbers before invoicing.

rachel-legal: Proposal: Accept split billing and two POs. For signing: allow delegated signature for POC (AM signature OK) provided the FO includes this clause: "For the POC term only, authorized sales representative may execute order form on Customer's behalf." If value > $150k require exec sign-off. Also counterproposal language for KMS: "Customer may use Customer-managed keys for Dedicated/Private deployments subject to reasonable security controls; Hosted deployments limited to crypto-in-transit and HSM storage."

taylor-sales: Sounds reasonable. Action items: @rachel-legal craft the POC exec-delegation clause; @maya-finance confirm acceptable net term (30/45) for POC milestone; @jordan-ops pick envelope option. I'll update the customer.

rachel-legal: Will draft now, will post diff in thread.

jordan-ops: Going with option 1 (two envelopes) to keep PO mapping explicit. I'll create both envelopes and tag them with each PO number; will leave routing for countersign to Sales Ops.

esign-bot: Created envelope #ENV-44812 for Entity A and #ENV-44813 for Entity B. Status: waiting on HealthSync AP approver. Link: https://docusign.redwood/ENV-44812

taylor-sales: Nice — thank you. I'll tell HealthSync AP to expect two envelopes and ask them to provide PO numbers + tax IDs. :thumbsup:

maya-finance: If customer insists on net60, escalate to revenue ops + legal for credit hold. For now I'll tentatively approve net45 for the POC if AM confirms usage forecast within 48h.

rachel-legal: Draft posted: /files/poc-signing-delegation-dpa-diff-3332109876.txt — includes BYOK fallback language and exec threshold. Please review. :eyes:

taylor-sales: Reviewing now, will ping customer with plan. Thanks everyone.
thread_summary: POC invoicing: HealthSync requests split billing, net60, and DPA BYOK/KMS redlines. Sales coordinates legal, finance, and ops; decision: two DocuSign envelopes (one per entity), draft delegation clause for POC, finance tentatively accepts net45 pending usage forecast; envelopes created by esign-bot.
